CERTIFICATE OF COMPLIANCE AND SERVICE
Pursuant to S. Ct. R. 33.1(h), I certify that the brief of Huang Tiange, et al. as
amici curiae in support of petitioners contains 6,784 words, excluding parts exempted by S. Ct. R. 33.1(d).
Pursuant to S. Ct. R. 29.2, I certify that 40 copies in booklet format  of the brief of
Huang Tiange, et al. as amici curiae in support of petitioners  are sent to the Clerk
of the Supreme Court  of the United States  through the United Parce l Service via
Next Day Air postage prepaid within 3 days after its submission to this Court’s electronic filing system on this 4th day of September, 2026.
Lastly, I certify pursuant to S. Ct. R. 29.5(c), 3 copies of the brief of Huang Tiange,
et al. as amici curiae in support of petitioners  are served all parties required to be
served have been served via email and United States Postal Service via Priority
Mail postage prepaid, this 4th day of September, 2026.
[See attached service list]

2

I declare under penalty of perjury that the foregoing is true and correct.
Executed on September 4, 2026.
